title: 喝口水慢下来
description: 成人坐在休息区长凳，放松双手，喝水看向空墙。

art_direction.medium: linocut print with indigo shadows and ochre highlights
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult sits comfortably on a bench outside the mat area, holding an unbranded water bottle with one relaxed hand while the other rests on the thigh. The climbing shoes have been loosened and the gaze turns toward an empty low wall in the distance. Capture a quiet pause with easy breathing and unhurried posture. A towel, plain bag, and soft daylight make recovery a concrete ordinary part of the session. Use risograph-inspired print design with limited coral and navy ink, grain within drawn forms, and intentional simplified silhouettes. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
